rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms coordinating rents, lease terms or occupancy
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.effective_date_note: Source says 'effective July 2025'; exact day not given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect.
rules.review_note: Article II cite taken from the task's known-law list; the source cites 'ch. 158-2'. Enacted date and penalties are not stated in the source.

parsed.notes: The two candidates (c83 from D002 and c90 from D037) describe the same Hoboken ordinance, and their texts are identical, so I merged them into one record. The other categories have no usable Hoboken text. The only Hoboken sources are the link-only ecode360 pages D032–D034, which I could not read, so I did not add unverified rules for rent control or the other categories.
